mintAuthority.summary: Native standalone uMINT has one default-admin EOA and a separate minter/enforcer EOA. Mint bytecode is non-upgradeable, but roles, transfer rules and issuer accounting remain privileged.

controls.label: Native uMINT role-gated issuance surface

sources.label: DigiFT native uMINT disclosure within STEP2 application (March 20, 2025)

controls.evidence: Deployment-to-block-26110197 role-event replay and hasRole checks establish default-admin 0xdac87349d8afd2989515deadb3692bb8edf749c4 and MINTER/ENFORCER 0x3797416c447778b514939362cf1b41bbe23dcf58; both are code-empty EOAs. Default admin inherits every role, including mint and TA force transfer. Verified standalone CMTAT_EVCC has no proxy, delegatecall fallback or mint-logic upgrade entrypoint. Privileged setRuleEngine changes transfer validation, not bytecode; no economic mint cap is implemented.

controls.label: uMINT default-admin EOA
controls.evidence: Exhaustive role-event replay and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE)=true; getCode=0x. Default admin has every role through AuthorizationModule, including uncapped mint, enforcement, TA force transfer and setRuleEngine. Organizational signer identity and custody are not attested.

controls.label: uMINT minter and enforcer EOA
controls.evidence: Exhaustive role-event replay and pinned MINTER_ROLE/ENFORCER_ROLE membership confirm this EOA; getCode=0x. The admin can reassign roles. No cryptographic multisig or independently evidenced organizational threshold is inferred.

sources.label: Verified standalone uMINT source and ABI (no code-replacement path)
DigiFT native uMINT disclosure within STEP2 application (March 20, 2025)

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 26110197, complete role-event replay (seven grants/revocations) and direct hasRole/code reads resolve the current default-admin EOA 0xdac87349d8afd2989515deadb3692bb8edf749c4 and minter/enforcer EOA 0x3797416c447778b514939362cf1b41bbe23dcf58. Default admin inherits every role; standalone verified source has uncapped mint and mutable rule-engine authorization, but no code-replacement path. The native share is distinct from DigiFT depositary receipts. Public materials do not supply binding native PPM, current independent financial reconciliation, or organizational signing independence; immutable mint bytecode supplies none of those missing facts. Organizational identity, independence and MPC/HSM signing policies of the two identified EOA controllers remain undisclosed. Native PPM and current independent token-to-fund financial reconciliation remain private. W1R35 re-read DigiFT's March 20, 2025 native-fund legal disclosure: the Singapore VCC fund is neither regulated nor supervised by MAS, although its investment manager holds a MAS capital-markets-services licence. Supervision none applies to the fund claim, not to the separately regulated manager or distributor, and does not imply that those entities lack regulation.
review.reviewer: Refine04 pinned native role census; W1R35 primary-source fund-supervision review

scopedQuestions.question: Organizational identity, independence and MPC/HSM/signing policy of this identified default-admin EOA remain undisclosed; its on-chain role membership and uncapped native mint authority are established.

Organizational identity, independence and MPC/HSM/signing policy of this identified minter/enforcer EOA remain undisclosed. Its role membership is established, without any independently attested organizational signing threshold.
